visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with dark hair in a purple striped shirt watches intently as an adult hand opens a small white box to reveal a clear bottle with a yellow bear-shaped cap. The background shows a cluttered indoor setting. (2) The scene shifts to a young boy in an orange shirt lying on a bed with a pink Kirby plush; a white product box with a yellow bear logo is held in the foreground. (3) The boy sits up in a brightly lit bedroom, wearing yellow patterned shorts and a beige T-shirt, talking and gesturing with his hands. (4) On a grey sofa, an adult's hands hold the yellow-capped bottle while the boy sits nearby, looking skeptical; the lighting is bright and natural. (5) The young girl takes the bottle, applies liquid to her thumb, and makes a face of extreme disgust, sticking her tongue out. (6) The boy resists on the sofa, burying his face in his hands and later a cushion, appearing to cry while the adult tries to approach him. (7) In a more dimly lit living room, the boy is seen asleep on the grey sofa; a woman with short brown hair in a white Mickey Mouse T-shirt carefully paints his thumbnail with the clear liquid. (8) The woman looks into the camera and makes an 'OK' sign with her fingers, holding the bottle triumphantly. (9) A close-up shot shows a shiny, treated fingernail; finally, the boy and woman smile at the camera together in the living room as digital confetti animation appears.

The video combines entertainment through sibling reactions with a practical 'how-to' demonstration of applying the product while the child is asleep.
